basic_details.job_title: WCD Bijapur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Gender Specialist, Office Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.details: Age relaxation for all posts: State Government instructions As per instructions issued from time to time; maximum age with all relaxations not more than 45 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Gender Specialist: Graduate degree in Social Work or other social fields, with at least 3 years of gender-related work in government or semi-government institutions and at least 3 years of experience in women's issues. Office Assistant: Graduation or Diploma in Accounts or another field with Accounts as a subject, with at least 3 years of accounts work in government or semi-government institutions. Both posts need good computer knowledge including MS Office and computer typing.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Graduate degree in Social Work / other social fields; minimum 3 years of gender-related work in government / semi-government institutions; minimum 03 years of experience in women's issues; good computer knowledge with MS Office and computer typing. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of gender-related work in government / semi-government institutions; minimum 03 years of experience in women's issues. Age limit: 21 to 35 years. Pay: 25780.00 (Pay Matrix Level 08). Qualification required: Graduation / Diploma in Accounts / other field with Accounts as one subject; minimum 3 years of accounts-related work in government / semi-government institutions; good computer knowledge with MS Office and computer typing. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of accounts-related wo

salary_details.pay_scale: Gender Specialist Rs. 25780 per month (Level 08); Office Assistant Rs. 18420 per month (Level 06); consolidated contract pay

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the skill test/interview.

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format printed with the notice.
Paste a self-attested latest passport size photo with the signature half on the form.
Attach certificates and mark sheets attested by a Gazetted Officer or self-attested, in serial order.
Write the post name, sender's name and full address with email and mobile number on the envelope and the form.
Send by registered post / speed post to the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Office of the Collector, Bijapur (C.G.) PIN 494444 by 30-11-2026.
important_instructions: Applications accepted only by registered post / speed post up to the fixed date Incomplete, unclear or wrong applications will be rejected without separate notice Government / semi-government employees must attach the employer's NOC, otherwise the application will not be considered Voluntary service certificates are not accepted as experience No travel or other allowance for the skill test / interview Selected candidates must give a notarised affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper about marriage age

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Women and Child Development Department, Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Women and Child Development Department, Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Gender Specialist, 1 Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Women and Child Development Department, Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format printed on pages 5 and 6 of the notice) and send it to District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development Officer, Office of the Collector (Women and Child Development Department Branch), District Bijapur (C.G.) PIN 494444, by registered post / speed post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: State Government instructions As per instructions issued from time to time; maximum age with all relaxations not more than 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 25780.00 (Pay Matrix Level 08) for Gender Specialist, 18420.00 (Pay Matrix Level 06) for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Gender Specialist: Graduate degree in Social Work or other social fields, with at least 3 years of gender-related work in government or semi-government institutions and at least 3 years of experience in women's issues. Office Assistant: Graduation or Diploma in Accounts or another field with Accounts as a subject, with at least 3 years of accounts work in government or semi-government institutions. Both posts need good computer knowledge including MS Office and computer typing. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh; only a residence certificate issued by the competent officer is accepted. Good knowledge of computers including MS Office and computer typing is essential. Qualification must be from a recognised institution or university and held by the last date of application.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Employees removed for proven misconduct or financial irregularity while working in a Child Care Institution, Sakhi One Stop Centre, Mission Vatsalya or Women Empowerment Centre. Candidates who married before the minimum age fixed for marriage. Candidates married to a person whose spouse is already living, unless the Government exempts.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit on 80 marks (qualification percentage up to 60, extra experience up to 18, Chhattisgarh native bonus 2). Interview / Skill Test (20 marks) for candidates called in 1:10 ratio. Final selection list. Up to 60 marks by weightage on the percentage in the minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract on consolidated pay for a maximum of 2 years at first. May be extended by 1 year each time by the District Collector on suitability. Appointment purely temporary; may be ended without giving reasons.
